RapidAPI key authentication. Requires both X-RapidAPI-Key and X-RapidAPI-Host headers.
Successful localization with quality gate results

The ListLoco API localizes e-commerce product listings into marketplace-compliant and glossary-consistent text, primarily for Amazon. It verifies each listing through a deterministic quality gate to ensure compliance and accuracy in translation, from English to German.
